arms.freeze: gc.collect(); gc.freeze() once after startup imports (the shipped change)
arms.freeze-warm: not shipped: freeze once after the first request's collection, so the lazily imported agent and provider modules are frozen too

decision: ship freeze: p50 -18%, p95 -33%, total collection time -23%, turn p50 -13%, peak RSS unchanged (200.0 vs 200.3 MB) and the second-half RSS slope unchanged (1.15 vs 1.55 KB/s); every request is still followed by a full collection. freeze-warm is recorded as a proposal only (p50 9 ms, -93%), because it freezes whatever concurrent requests hold at that moment and its RSS slope was higher (7.3 KB/s).
hypothesis: Collecting once and freezing after startup imports lowers the full collection BoundedBody runs after every admitted request, with no RSS growth under sustained concurrent load.
method: runtime_api served by uvicorn (1 worker) on loopback; Team's own inference client and chat orchestrator drive 2000 turns (start plus one Action round and resume, 4000 admitted requests) from 8 concurrent workers over 16 threads; the provider is a loopback stand-in for the OpenAI Responses endpoint (real ChatOpenAI and SDK path, 0.2 s per response); the timed call is the BoundedBody gc.collect; RSS sampled every 0.5 s. No provider cost.
metric: per-request gc.collect duration (p50/p95/total) and process RSS over the run
